newsitem.title: USA: CET makes changes to save up to $4 mln/yr.
newsitem.headline: CET makes changes to save up to $4 mln/yr.

text.p: CET Environmental Services Inc said Friday it had eliminated unprofitable operations and made other changes that should save up to $4 million a year in overhead and indirect costs.
Other changes include restructuring its benefits programs and tightening up operational procedures to decrease overhead, CET said.

The company made the announcement after reporting a third quarter loss of $2.8 million, or $0.56 per share. It attributed the loss to unproductive operations, nonrecurring charges for discontinuing those operations, and charges to reflect lower margins on certain projects.
The company had a profit of $0.11 per share in the 1995 third quarter.
